method.bars: 5m Yahoo chart, ~1 month: data.batch_fetch(mode='hybrid') with the crypto venues held in cooldown (OKX/Binance/Bybit/Coinbase return <= 350 5m bars)
method.hold: focus session only (no overnight): exit at the session's last bar
method.same_bar: stop before target; no same-bar entry fill
method.note: The first replay of crypto in this repo; no rule was ever tuned on crypto. Engine v1.4.1 as published: crypto on the equity clock (blue, orange, RVOL and signals stop at 16:00 ET; the gap runs from the prior 15:55 ET close to the 09:30 ET open and is provisional before 09:30). 184 of the 196 classic trades are gap fades and 192 triggered before 09:30 ET, 135 of them in the hour after midnight ET, right after blue resets; the median stop is 0.43% of price, so the 0.15% round trip costs 0.51R a trade. 36 of the 48 universe names: Yahoo lists no 5m bars under 9 symbols (MATIC, SUI, APT, UNI, PEPE, TAO, IMX, GRT, STX) and other tokens under 3 (ARB-USD is ARbit, TON-USD is TON Token, JUP-USD a second Jupiter), which are excluded. Yahoo reports zero volume on about half of its 5m crypto bars. Corrected 2026-10-04: the first version of this file also replayed those 3 tokens (no trades on them here; 3 in the bar-by-bar check). causal_check: replay_sessions.replay searches the premarket with the side fixed by the 09:30 gap; graded bar by bar as the desk saw it, the same bars give more trades, still negative.

causal_check.rule: first bar whose decision-time row is tradeable with its trigger on that bar (causal_check.py)
